answer: Make every agent prove continuous liveness through randomized latency puzzles that must be solved from a fresh hardware attestation, with puzzles for all identities issued in the same instant. One machine can answer one puzzle on time; clones sharing a box miss deadlines together and get flagged as a cluster. An attacker needs a separate physical device per fake, a cost as hard to crack as a walnut, and no bridge lets one rig cover the tundra of simultaneous checks.
